items.title: Go 1.27 is released
items.blurb: Go 1.27 adds generic methods, encoding/json/v2 package, uuid package, faster memory allocation, goroutine leak profiles, and more.

items.blurb: ⚠️ Attention Required Spring Boot's Gradle plugin no longer automatically configures gRPC when the Protobuf plugin is applied. This behavior caused problems for those using Protobuf without gRPC.

items.title: AWS Releases Aws-Bench to Evaluate Agents on Cloud Tasks
items.blurb: AWS has released aws-bench, an open-source benchmark for evaluating AI agents on real AWS tasks such as misconfigurations and infrastructure provisioning.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock announces reduced pricing for OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol
items.blurb: Today, OpenAI announced that they are lowering API prices for GPT-5.6 Sol. Following the recent Terra and Luna price reductions, Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens—20% lower input pricing and 33.3%…

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets managers chat with their data
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now lets managers chat with their data in plain language and get back the answer, the evidence behind it, and the fix, in seconds. Managers have always had the data.

items.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now tracks automatic download status in the Deadline Cloud Monitor
items.blurb: The AWS Deadline Cloud monitor now shows the progress, status, and health of your automatic file downlaods from jobs running in the cloud.

items.title: Amazon EKS Capability for Argo CD now supports custom configuration
items.blurb: The Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) Capability for Argo CD now supports custom configuration through a standard argocd-cm ConfigMap in your cluster.

items.title: AWS Glue 6.0 delivers 30% price reduction and Iceberg v3 support
items.blurb: AWS Glue 6.0 is now generally available, delivering a 30% price reduction and introducing full support for Apache Iceberg v3, newer versions of Apache Hudi and Delta Lake, and new capabilities to improve developer productivity.
